subject: satrw
name: Digital SAT Reading and Writing
ced_source: College Board Digital SAT Suite specifications (domains/skills)

topics.title: Central Ideas and Details
topics.learning_objective: Determine the central idea of a text and/or interpret the key details supporting that idea.

topics.title: Command of Evidence (Textual)
topics.learning_objective: Determine the textual evidence (a fact, detail, or example from a text) that best supports a specified claim or point.

topics.title: Command of Evidence (Quantitative)
topics.learning_objective: Determine the quantitative evidence (data from an informational graphic) that best supports a specified claim or point.

topics.title: Inferences
topics.learning_objective: Draw reasonable inferences based on explicit and/or implicit information and ideas in a text.

topics.title: Words in Context
topics.learning_objective: Determine the meaning of words/phrases in context.

topics.title: Text Structure and Purpose
topics.learning_objective: Analyze why an author structures a text or includes a portion.

topics.title: Cross-Text Connections
topics.learning_objective: Compare/contrast ideas across two short related texts.

topics.title: Rhetorical Synthesis
topics.learning_objective: Combine notes to achieve a stated rhetorical goal.

topics.title: Transitions
topics.learning_objective: Choose the most logical transition word or sentence.

topics.title: Boundaries
topics.learning_objective: Punctuate and join clauses correctly (commas, semicolons, colons, dashes, periods); fix splices, fragments, and run-ons.

topics.title: Form, Structure, and Sense
topics.learning_objective: Ensure subject-verb agreement, pronoun clarity/case, verb tense and form, modifier placement, parallelism, and logical comparisons.
